title: Personalised NFTs
tagline: This project aim to generate NFTs based on user's personality:)
description: ETHOnline Hackathon 2021 solo project - Aim to generate NFTs based on user's personality. This project uses NFTPort as a core tool to upload file and metadata to IPFS. Once user completed their personality test, the site will generate a NFT for user to mint it onChain. I had also deployed the front-end site to IPFS as a demo.
how_its_made:
This project uses NFTPort as a core tool to upload file and metadata to IPFS. Once user completed their personality test, the site will generate a NFT for user to mint it onChain. I had also deployed the front-end site to IPFS as a demo. 

- Oregon Vocational Interest Scales (ORVIS): https://ipip.ori.org/newORVISSurvey.htm

- CSS: https://tailwindcss.com/

- API: https://docs.pokemontcg.io/api-reference/cards/search-cards/

- Out of the box tools: https://github.com/tomhirst/solidity-nextjs-starter

- NFTPort for minting: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=M2mBg7xHmY8

- IPFS for NTF storage: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1xloqhD5C_8
